test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Many companies __displaced paying__ income tax last year.
solution:
The correct answer is **"evaded paying".**
